scientific_integrity: An exact exhaustive discrete-Morse boundary computation provides integral homotopy equivalences for three explicit finite complexes. A separately implemented complete simplicial homology calculation over two fields corroborates face enumeration and reduced ranks. Numerical checks alone are not substituted for an integral attaching-map proof.
scientific_limitations: One fixed 14-vertex graph and all its 24 edges; no graph-family or equivariant claim; literature coverage is not a uniqueness certificate; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Uniform edge-deletion splitting for the rhombic dodecahedral matching complex
